raw_text: 4-Fluoronitrobenzene (1.00 mmol, 1.0 equiv) and piperazine (1.20 mmol, 1.2 equiv) were dissolved in DMF to give a substrate concentration of 0.30 M. The mixture was heated at 120 C under air for 6 h. Standard aqueous workup and purification gave the arylated piperazine product in 81% isolated yield.
